AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
https://ag-ui.com

 
 

 
 
The open protocol that connects any agent to any app.
 
 
    
 
 
Docs · Examples · Spec · Discord
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.

items.title: Show HN: I built the Apple Screen Time I needed to stop doomscrolling / phubbing
items.contentSnippet:
Hi, I'm Juan and together with a friend we built LightScroll.
It's a(nother) screen time app which helps you set limits for websites on your macOS, and apps/websites on iOS.
Every time you open a website you created a rule for, you'll get a small randomized pause to make the usage really intentional, and then you'll start a session. Once the session ends, it gets locked again.
Once your daily limit is up, you can even require a code from an Accountability Partner to continue.

items.title: Show HN: Nanossh – A lightweight SSH-like remote shell in Rust(2.5MB RAM, 1 RTT)
items.contentSnippet:
This is not a replacement for OpenSSH in multi-user enterprise environments. It deliberately omits X11 forwarding, SFTP/SCP subsystems, complex channel multiplexing, and LDAP/PAM authentication in favor of simplicity, speed, and a tiny footprint.
Beyond reviving old hardware, it's also useful for Raspberry Pi Zero boards, minimal containers, and early-boot initramfs environments.
Code, protocol spec, and automated tests are on GitHub: https://github.com/sumant1122/nanossh
Feedback and critiques
